Your server. Your VPN. Nukemichi just sets it up.

Give the app access to your server. It installs everything, sets it up, and hides your traffic from filters.
Connect or import
Already have a VPN link from a friend or another service? Just paste it in.

Advanced mode
What it unlocks
Choose the transport and flow control by hand instead of the automatic default
Reconfigure REALITY camouflage: the masking domain, TLS fingerprint, and short ID
Adjust the VPN tunnel\'s MTU
Edit the full Xray configuration yourself, including a raw JSON editor that gets checked before it runs
Swap out the local tunnel Xray sends its traffic through
This is not what most people need

It\'s for people who already understand REALITY, XHTTP, and the Xray config, and have a real reason to change them by hand. Getting any of it wrong can make you easier to fingerprint, or break your connection outright. Nothing in the app stops you.
